tools.name: shot
tools.description: Take screenshots of a public web page in real browser engines (default: newest Chrome, 1920x1080, light scheme). Returns the images inline (PNG) plus download links. Costs 65 Payloads (0.0065 EUR) per screenshot = browser version x viewport x colour scheme, 40 from the 13th screenshot of one job. Br

tools.name: markdown
tools.description: Fetch a public web page and return its main content as Markdown (inline text). Costs 45 Payloads (0.0045 EUR) per page.

tools.name: pdf
tools.description: Render a public web page to PDF (Chromium). Returns the PDF inline (base64, up to 4 MB) and a download link. Costs 150 Payloads (0.015 EUR) per page.

tools.name: relay_check
tools.description: Test a public Nostr relay. mode "quick" (default, 200 Payloads = 0.02 EUR): DNS, TLS, WebSocket, NIP-11, publish/query, latency, stability. mode "conformance" (800 Payloads = 0.08 EUR): NIP-01, filters, event semantics, limits. Returns the JSON report inline (per check: pass, fail, warn, skip, info)

tools.name: balance
tools.description: Current balance of the wallet behind the API key (Payloads and EUR) and where to top up. Free.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: shot, markdown · Private data: balance · Public sink: relay_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: shot, markdown · Private data: balance · Public sink: relay_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
